column2: The Emperor of Lilliput, a mature man drawn with normal adult human proportions, slightly taller and more upright than his courtiers, strong aquiline (hooked) nose, olive skin, stern majestic bearing. Plain early-18th-century court dress: dark green coat, gold helmet with a tall plume of feathers, holding a drawn sword. Front view.

The Empress of Lilliput, a small slender woman drawn with normal adult human proportions, cold dignified expression, heavy formal early-18th-century court gown in deep purple with a stiff bodice and wide skirt, hair dressed up with a small crown. Front view.

Flimnap, the Lord High Treasurer of Lilliput, a thin tall man drawn with normal adult human proportions, gaunt face, sharp calculating eyes, long narrow silhouette, dark grey-black coat with a white cravat, a long powdered wig, holding a small ledger. Front view.

Reldresal, Principal Secretary for private affairs of Lilliput, a medium-build man drawn with normal adult human proportions, narrow gentle eyes, calm mild face, short brown tied-back wig, sober brown coat and waistcoat, a rolled document in hand. Front view.

Skyresh Bolgolam, High Admiral of Lilliput, a heavy thick-bodied man drawn with normal adult human proportions, sour gloomy face, heavy brows, dark navy coat with broad cuffs, sash, big boots, a sword at the hip. Front view.

The Emperor of Blefuscu, a man drawn with normal adult human proportions, round friendly face, calm generous expression, a silver crown, pale blue and white early-18th-century court coat, no plume, open welcoming stance. Clearly different from the Emperor of Lilliput (hooked nose, gold plumed helmet). Front view.
